opening.argument: The video presents StrongBlock nodes as a paid income stream, beginning with a purchase of 10 STRONG at approximately $6,100 and tying a recurring $15 maintenance fee to claimed returns of $366 per day and $10,980 per month. Although the speaker acknowledges that viewers must be able to tolerate fully losing the money, he still directly urges participation: "Do it." Addressing viewers who are undecided and pairing substantial income figures with that encouragement promotes buying into a paid node-return scheme rather than merely reporting on it.
